name: Lvgl → Widget Redraw
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#actions-action) redraws the entire screen, or optionally only selected widgets. It does not change any widget properties. It is mostly useful to redraw the screen after resuming LVGL from the paused state.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID (or a list of IDs) of a widget configured in LVGL which you want to redraw; if omitted, the entire screen will be redrawn.

config_entries.label: Lvgl ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the LVGL instance to redraw.
